bio.text: Joe Wilson represents South Carolina's 2nd Congressional District and was elected to Congress in 2001.
He was born in Charleston, holds an undergraduate degree from Washington & Lee University and a law degree from the University of South Carolina, and practiced real estate law.
Before Congress he served 17 years in the South Carolina State Senate and worked on the staffs of Sen. Strom Thurmond and Rep. Floyd Spence.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserves from 1972 to 1975 and then in the South Carolina Army National Guard, retiring as a Colonel in 2003 after 31 years in the armed forces.
